briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion-2 training run hits 10^27 FLOP milestone as US-China compute race intensifies

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate toward AGI with new model releases and massive infrastructure builds. Geopolitical tensions drive export controls and strategic alliances while safety concerns mount over uncontrolled capabilities.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deploys Orion-2 internal previews showing major gains in long-horizon reasoning. Anthropic ships Claude 4 Opus with enhanced agentic capabilities while Google DeepMind releases Gemini 3 and Meta open-sources Llama 4 405B variant.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. NIST releases new red-teaming guidelines for multi-agent deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC begins volume production of 1.4nm AI chips for NVIDIA Blackwell successors. Microsoft and xAI announce joint $20B data center campus in Texas with 200k H100-equivalent GPUs.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first system to reach 10^28 FLOP training cross the AGI threshold before international governance frameworks can be ratified?
